note: Schema only. No candidate instances exist yet under this pilot as of WP0. Modeled after the immutable current+history pattern already used by state/proposal_ledger/proposal_ledger.json, but this is a separate pilot-local file -- never written into the canonical proposal ledger.
immutability_rule: Entries are append-only. Rejected candidates are retained permanently, never deleted or overwritten. Only the winner is never retained-only.

required_fields.parent_candidate_id: string or null; null for a hypothesis's first candidate
required_fields.hypothesis_id: string, 'SSC1D-H<n>', must exist in the diagnosis contract ledger
required_fields.semantic_config_hash: hash of the full effective config (parent YAML v1.0.0 + this candidate's diff)
required_fields.changed_fields: array of {dot_path, from, to} -- explicit diff from strategies/ST_SESSION_SWEEP_CONTINUATION_V1.yaml
required_fields.development_dataset_hash: hash of the DEVELOPMENT_REUSABLE dataset slice used (see dataset role manifest)
required_fields.setup_decomposition: object keyed by S1/S2/S3, session, direction, regime, exit_reason
required_fields.decision_reason: string, must reference the owning hypothesis's preregistered rejection_condition

governance_notes: No OOS access is permitted while this ledger is being populated (development phase only).

Budget accounting against max_major_hypotheses=3, max_total_candidates=20, max_search_time=3h (see SSC_ONE_DAY_DEMO_PILOT_V2.md section 6) must be derivable from this ledger's entry count and timestamps.
At candidate freeze (see SSC_ONE_DAY_DEMO_PILOT_V2.md section 9), a hash of the full ledger file at that moment is recorded in the freeze record.
